Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 2026

Information we collect

When you sign in, we store your display name, email (if provided by your sign-in provider), a verified phone number used to keep voting fair, and an optional bio. We also store the polls you create, your votes, comments, likes, and the people you follow.

How we use your information

Your data powers the core features of Peopoll: showing your polls, ranking feeds, enabling conversations, and connecting you with other people. Aggregated, anonymized vote counts are shown publicly on each poll. A verified phone number is used solely to ensure one person counts as one voter.

What is public

Polls, vote tallies, comments, and your public profile (name and bio) are visible to other users. Your phone number and direct messages are private. Direct messages are visible only to the participants of a conversation.

Guest accounts

You can use Peopoll as an anonymous guest. Guest activity is tied to a temporary account and may be lost if you clear your browser or sign out.

Data retention & deletion

You can edit your profile at any time in Settings. To request deletion of your account and associated data, contact us through the Help page in the app.

Third-party services

Peopoll uses Google Firebase for authentication, data storage, and abuse protection (App Check / reCAPTCHA). Their handling of data is governed by Google’s privacy policy.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as the app evolves. Material changes will be reflected here with an updated date.

Questions about this policy? Reach out through the Help page in the Peopoll app.
